title: Hue Control: inspector never received plugin events (dead listeners)
description:
The property inspector's custom event listeners never fired. OpenDeck does not re-emit a plugin's payload as a message named after it; it relays ONE 'sendToPropertyInspector' message whose payload carries the real event name. So addEventListener('paired'/'targets'/'bridges'/'pairError'/'targetError') was dead code.

Impact: nothing downstream of pairing worked. The inspector showed the waiting prompt forever, never stored {ip,username} in global settings, and never revealed the Target picker. Discovery results and target lists were silently dropped too.

Fix (commit cca1fbc, branch fix/hue-pi-event-relay): subscribe once to sendToPropertyInspector and dispatch on payload.event.

Verified by loading the built inspector in Chromium against a mock OpenDeck socket and driving IP -> Pair -> error 101 -> button pressed: the panel prompts, keeps polling, then pairs and lists targets.
close_reason: Inspector listeners were dead: OpenDeck relays plugin payloads as one sendToPropertyInspector message whose payload carries the inner event name. Listeners now dispatch on payload.event. Verified in Chromium against a mock OpenDeck socket: prompt -> polling -> paired -> targets listed.
